svg.title: ETICS-BankAI: pipeline, architecture and tools
svg.desc: Six-step pipeline (upload, processing, AI analysis, validation, storage, review and dashboard), system architecture (users, Streamlit frontend, FastAPI backend, local AI tools, PostgreSQL), V1 status, tech stack and next steps.
